IS-03.name: TEXT_SYMBOL_PATTERN
IS-03.definition: text is non-alphabetic or very short (math symbol)

IS-04.name: TEXT_PUNCTUATION
IS-04.definition: text_a ends with period (sentence boundary signal)

IS-05.name: TEXT_CAPITAL_START
IS-05.definition: text_b starts with capital letter (sentence start signal)

IS-06.name: TEXT_APPENDIX_LETTER
IS-06.definition: text_a matches appendix letter pattern (B.1, A.2)

IS-07.name: VISUAL_TOC_CONTEXT
IS-07.definition: page is TOC page (table of contents layout)

IS-10.name: SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_INTERPRETATION
IS-10.definition: interpreting punctuation + capitalization as sentence boundary → different text unit
IS-10.machine_observable: PARTIAL (raw signals are B, interpretation is C)
IS-10.note: Raw signals (period, capitalization) are machine-observable (Category B). But interpreting them as sentence boundary = text unit boundary requires semantic judgment (Category C). Period could be decimal/abbreviation; capitalization could be proper noun.

A_existing_uncombined.explanation: P4 v3 Design already attempted to combine all geometric features. Irreducible FP proves geometry alone is insufficient. The gap is not combination; it is information space exclusion.

B_new_machine_observable.explanation: All textual and visual information sources Human used are potentially machine-observable. P1 has text content; P6 has region types. The information exists in DICE but P4's contract excludes it.
B_new_machine_observable.implementation_candidate: Textual Structure Feature + Visual Context Feature (NOT AUTHORIZED)

C_inherently_semantic.explanation: Sentence boundary interpretation requires semantic judgment. Even with raw signal detection, interpretation of '. + capitalization = different sentence = different text unit' is inherently semantic.

TOC_SECTION_NUMBER_TITLE.missing_info: numbering pattern + readable word detection + page context
TOC_SECTION_NUMBER_TITLE.potential_source: Textual Structure Feature + P6 Visual Context

FORMULA_FRAGMENT_WIDE.potential_source: Character class detection + P6 formula region
FORMULA_FRAGMENT_WIDE.shrinkage_possible: partial (line_obs>15 already DETERMINISTIC_BLOCK; line_obs<=15 needs visual context)

BODY_TEXT_CONTINUATION.potential_source: text semantics layer (requires interpretation, not just detection)

textual_structure_feature.description: Pattern analysis on P1 observation text: number detection, symbol detection, punctuation, capitalization, word detection
textual_structure_feature.output: TextStructureProfile {is_number, is_readable_word, is_symbol, ends_with_period, starts_capital, text_length_category}
textual_structure_feature.note: Does NOT modify P4. Would be a new information layer usable by Relation Assessment or P7.1.

visual_context_feature.description: Page-level region type from P6: TOC, BODY, FORMULA, TABLE
visual_context_feature.note: P6 already classifies regions. This would expose P6's classification to boundary assessment.

sentence_boundary_signal.description: Raw signals: ends_with_period, starts_capital (Category B detection, but interpretation is Category C)
sentence_boundary_signal.note: Could reduce AMBIGUOUS zone for BODY_CONT, but cannot fully resolve. Interpretation remains Human-owned.

human_workload_scaling.architecture_principle: Human workload should NOT scale linearly with corpus size

scenario_A_bad.condition: no shrinkage, no capability, every AMBIGUOUS needs Human

scenario_B_desired.condition: Category B modes shrink, document-type capability accumulates, AMBIGUOUS dedup

scenario_C_expansion.condition: new document types produce new boundary modes

human_workload_scaling.key_distinction: more data (same type) should NOT increase workload; more boundary classes (new types) temporarily increases workload
human_workload_scaling.correct_statement: Architecture is designed to prevent linear workload growth, but this remains empirically unvalidated.

steps: Information Source Attribution (which IS did Human use?)
Category B → Candidate IS Expansion → Generalization Evaluation → Gate → Machine Boundary (shrinkage) OR Keep Human
boundary_intelligence_loop.goal: Human Review only exists at boundaries that cannot be reliably auto-decided
